question: Khelo India Dus ka Dum tournament was organised in how many cities in celebration of International Women’s Day 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ten**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Khelo India Dus ka Dum tournament was held in **ten cities across India** as part of the celebration of International Women's Day 2023.
 
• This initiative was launched under the **Khelo India Programme**, which aims to nurture sports culture at the grassroots level and provide a platform for aspiring athletes.
 
• The tournament specifically focused on encouraging **women's participation in sports** and celebrating the achievements of women athletes.
 
• Around **1,000 women athletes** participated in the tournament, showcasing their talents in various sports disciplines.
 
• The initiative aligns with the Indian government's efforts to promote **gender equality and empowerment** through sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khelo India Programme:**

 
 
• Launched in 2018 by the Government of India to revive and promote sports culture in the country.
 
• It aims to identify and nurture young talent at the grassroots level and support them with infrastructure, training, and financial assistance.
 
• Initiatives under Khelo India include the **Khelo India Youth Games**, **Khelo India University Games**, and specialized tournaments like Dus ka Dum.
 
 
 
• **International Women's Day:**
 
 
• Celebrated annually on **March 8th**, this day highlights the social, economic, cultural, and political achievements of women globally.
 
• The theme for International Women's Day 2023 was "**DigitALL: Innovation and technology for gender equality**."
 
• This day also serves as a call to action for accelerating gender parity and empowering women worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Women in Sports:**
 
 
• India has seen a significant rise in women athletes excelling at international events such as the **Olympics**, **Asian Games**, and **Commonwealth Games**.
 
• Prominent women athletes like **PV Sindhu**, **Mary Kom**, and **Sania Mirza** have inspired millions of young girls to take up sports.
 
• Initiatives like the Khelo India Dus ka Dum tournament aim to create more opportunities for women to participate in sports and break gender stereotypes.
